Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
The reliance on a defunct sanctions framework ignores the reality of geopolitical shifts. Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (R_net: 6.5, Uncertainty z: 1)
North Korea is hardening its nuclear-armed status, taking advantage of a divided U.N. Security Council and closer ties with Russia and China to bypass international pressure.

The Poison:
The continued reliance on a 2016-era sanctions model creates a false sense of progress while the nuclear threat grows unchecked.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a HOW error. The proposed 'how' (sanctions) no longer matches the current geopolitical 'where' (a world where Russia and China veto enforcement).

Social Physics Analysis:
The strategy relies on the projection that China and Russia will act against their own interests to support South Korean security. This ignores the current reality of power dynamics.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated diplomatic goals and ground-level reality, it plots a direct trajectory toward Destruction. The strategy is a pretext for inaction.

The Unavoidable Truth: Current sanctions are failing to prevent North Korea from expanding its nuclear capabilities.

The Unavoidable Lie: That diplomatic pressure on China and Russia will return the region to 2016-era stability.

The diplomatic framework is obsolete. Clinging to a failed model of pressure while the underlying power structure has shifted is a dangerous delusion.
